note: The chat session of every DP-H request is created with the statement the renderer's createSession sends to db_execute, before the profile is restricted. This file is the statement as the renderer builds it. src/features/chat/chatApi.createSessionStatement.test.ts runs the renderer function and fixes that its db_execute call equals this file; the Rust harness builds its statement from `paramSlots` and compares sql, method and slots with this file at run time (setup receipt chatSession.statementMatchesRenderer). A change of the renderer statement fails the vitest first.
